input.summary: Remove Customer-payable liquidated damages for dependency delay; substitute equitable schedule adjustment
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by us, and an uncapped USD 25,000 per day charge for any dependency delay is far beyond our position. We have replaced it with an equitable adjustment of the affected dates; if a fixed amount is essential, we could consider an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees as the sole liquidated amount.

ops.oldText: Customer shall pay Vendor USD 25,000 per day as agreed liquidated damages for any delay in providing a dependency.
ops.newText: Customer is not liable for liquidated damages or penalties under this Agreement. If Customer's delay in providing an agreed dependency materially affects Vendor's performance, the affected dates and, where applicable, the affected Fees will be equitably adjusted through a change order, provided Vendor promptly notifies Customer of the delay and mitigates its effect.
